notes: Evening pop-up in an empty storefront on the parade route, next to the tree lighting. Times are based on past years.
summary: The Kitchen Incubator's pop-up market at Sterling's Sights & Sounds, the kickoff of the Christmas season downtown. It's in the empty storefront at 6 East 4th Street, between Sterling Barber Shop and Brito's Mexican Restaurant, right on the parade route and steps from the tree Santa lights. Expect very heavy foot traffic, and the parade is back this year. Bring marketing materials and small, no-fuss items to sample and sell. In past years the evening ran from 5 PM to fireworks at 8 PM; confirm this year's times with Krista.
